info.name: COMP3123 Assignment 2 API
info.description: Backend for Assignment 2 (Assignment 1 API plus search and profile picture upload). Run the whole collection in order with the Runner; it creates its own users (postmanA, postmanB). Login requests save tokenA/tokenB, create requests save employee ids. Upload requests read files from test-images/: set Postman Settings > General > Working directory to the postman/ folder of the repo. Signup and login share a rate limit (default 10 per 15 minutes). For a full Runner pass set AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=100 in the root .env and run docker compose up -d. All API routes also share a general limit of 100 requests per 15 minutes, and one run sends 58, so restart the backend (docker compose restart backend) before running it again. To show the 429, set AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX back to 10, restart, and send the rate limit request 11 times.
